hooks.name: Format backend (ESLint + Prettier)
hooks.description: After saving a TypeScript file in the backend, auto-format with Prettier and auto-fix with ESLint.

action.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24.22.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)/backend" && pnpm exec prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" >/dev/null 2>&1; pnpm exec eslint "{src,test}/**/*.ts" --fix >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
